about_the_game:
Maze Adventure is a level-based puzzle-solving game that takes you on a fantastic journey filled with unknowns and challenges. In the game, two protagonists—a mechanic and a sprinter—accidentally stumble into a time portal, only to be captured by savage tribesmen in a foreign land. It’s up to you to control them and embark on a thrilling escape.​

The game features a variety of richly designed levels, each presenting a carefully crafted challenge. You need to maneuver the protagonists through complex maps, converse with different characters, and pick up key clues from their dialogues to advance through the level. For example, when you trigger a manhunt just by carrying food up the stairs, you must keenly spot traces in the environment and use clues to find a safe hiding spot or open up a new escape route.​

Secret signal communication is a crucial way to obtain key intelligence. Cooperate tacitly with allies, pass information through precise secret signals to learn the enemy’s movements in advance and discover hidden passages—laying the groundwork for completing core missions such as puzzle-solving, stealing secrets, rescuing captives, and assassinating leaders. When trapped in a building surrounded by enemies, using secret signals to coordinate with allies allows you to break through the enemy’s defenses by surprise.​

Stealth tactics are equally indispensable. You can sneak quietly behind enemies and take them down with agile moves, or knock them out and quickly take their clothes to blend into the enemy ranks. This helps you avoid enemy searches and approach confidential documents, captive locations, or assassination targets without being detected.​

Only by successfully rescuing captives, stealing secrets, or assassinating leaders—and leading the protagonists to escape safely—can you win the level and move on to the next adventure. As the levels progress, the enemy’s defenses become tighter, and traps and puzzles emerge one after another. This requires you to constantly improve your strategic planning and adaptability. Come to The Lost Adventure, and use your wisdom and courage to guide the protagonists out of the foreign land and unlock the secrets behind the time portal.

content_descriptors.notes: WARNING: This game contains strong language and extreme violence.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: WINDOWS 10,11 (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel Celeron G1820 / AMD Athlon II X3 455
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 760 or AMD Radeon™ R7 260x with 2GB Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: WINDOWS 10,11 (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-3770 or AMD FX™-9590 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon™ RX 480 with 3GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Shader model 3.0，NVidia 7600，ATI X1600 Or higher
